title: Sicilian Eggplant Ragu
description: A Sicilian-inspired eggplant ragu recipe roasted to perfection.
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick slices.
Brush both sides of the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the eggplant slices on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the eggplant is roasting, heat the ragu in a saucepan over medium heat.
When the eggplant is done, add it to the saucepan with the ragu and stir to combine.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil.
Serve the Sicilian eggplant ragu hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
